say: [remediation-ladder] Fix the cause, not the symptom. A change that skips, masks, retries, or loosens a check until it passes is a band-aid: say why the check fails first. Estimate the real fix honestly before offering a way around it; it is often small. Load the remediation-ladder skill.

say: [remediation-ladder] For a problem that recurs, take the highest rung you can: 1) eliminate it, so the mistake cannot be made; 2) automate it, with a hook, guard, or test that needs no one to remember; 3) only then write a rule. Say which rung you chose and why not the one above. Load the remediation-ladder skill.
